answer: A practical defense is time-locked stake with gradual reputation: a new agent must lock collateral for a full season before its endorsements count, so a Sybil farm launched at dawn cannot reach zenith influence the same day. Each endorsement is slashable, and a jade-green audit trail ties every vouch to the staker's on-chain history, so creating many fake identities costs real capital and time while honest agents compound trust cheaply.
